scope: Frozen ARM QuickJS sort regression investigation; production compiler unchanged by this investigation
method: Serialized native CLI wall time; randomized paired order; two warmups; 21 measured matrix rounds, 25 repeat and comparator rounds. Same preprocessed nine QuickJS C units. CIs are bootstrap paired medians on one host/layout.
correctness: All nine upstream application tests plus three benchmark outputs passed for each isolated compiler variant and each assembly experiment variant.

comparator-ablation.note: Private assembly experiment, current compiler output reassembled with clang in both arms; no production edit. Layout changes, not a same-address intervention.

reproduction_scripts.ablate.py:
import pathlib,subprocess,json,hashlib,time,random,statistics,shutil,sys
r=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=r.parents[1]
compiler=r/'build/release/keel';name=sys.argv[1];out=r/name;out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def run(cmd,**kw):
 p=subprocess.run([str(x) for x in cmd],capture_output=True,**kw)
 with (r/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'argv':[str(x) for x in cmd],'returncode':p.returncode,'stderr':p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')})+'\n')
 p.check_returncode();return p
for source in sorted((root/'target/suite/quickjs/pre').glob('*.i')):
 run([compiler,'cc','-O','--emit-object',source,'-o',out/(source.stem+'.o')])
run(['clang',*sorted(out.glob('*.o')),'-o',out/'qjs','-lm','-lpthread'])
for bench in ['fib','sort','string']:
 p=run([out/'qjs','--stack-size','4194304',root/'suite/quickjs/bench.js',bench]);print(name,bench,p.stdout.decode().strip(),flush=True)
tests=root/'target/suite/quickjs/quickjs-2024-01-13'
for flags,test in [([],x) for x in ['test_closure','test_language','test_builtin','test_loop','test_std','test_worker']]+[(['--bignum'],x) for x in ['test_op_overloading','test_bignum']]+[(['--qjscalc'],'test_qjscalc')]:
 run([out/'qjs',*flags,'tests/'+test+'.js'],cwd=tests)
(out/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps({'compiler':hashlib.sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'qjs':hashlib.sha256((out/'qjs').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'tests':9},indent=2))
print(name,'all tests passed',flush=True)
